theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (C : ℕ) (N : ℕ → ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (x : ℕ → ℕ → Euclid P) (ι : Type) (g : ι → Euclid P → ℝ) (t : ι → ℝ), IsCompact K → (∀ j l, l < N j → x j l ∈ K) → (∀ j l, l < N j → w j l ≠ 0) → (∀ j, (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (N j), (w j l).natAbs) ≤ C) → (∀ k, Continuous (g k)) → (∀ k, Tendsto (fun j => ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (N j), (w j l : ℝ) * g k (x j l)) atTop (𝓝 (t k))) → ∃ (M : ℕ) (v : ℕ → ℤ) (y : ℕ → Euclid P), (∀ l < M, y l ∈ K) ∧ ∀ k, t k = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range M, (v l : ℝ) * g k (y l)
